question: Which young swimmer matched Michael Phelps’s achievement by setting three individual world records at one meet during the Canadian Trials?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Summer McIntosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Summer McIntosh** is a Canadian swimming sensation who achieved a historic milestone at the **2023 Canadian Swimming Trials** held in **Toronto**.
 
• During this single meet, she set **World Records** in both the **400m freestyle** (with a time of **3:56.08**) and the **400m individual medley** (with a time of **4:25.87**).
 
• By breaking multiple world records at a single trials event, she was widely compared to **Michael Phelps**, the legendary **American** swimmer, as she became the first person to hold the world record in both these diverse disciplines simultaneously since the **1970s**.
 
• Her performance was extraordinary as she broke **Katinka Hosszu’s** long-standing 400m
